text: dsh-session-nav（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：为 DeepSeek Harness 的对话提供 Codex 风格的会话导航时间线。它通过 shell.overlay 覆盖层和会话标题栏按钮接入界面，为用户消息、引导消息、命令及手动压缩轮次显示时间刻度。用户可以点击刻度或使用上下方向键定位对话，也能浏览尚未载入聊天窗口的较早消息；悬停时可查看提示内容、运行耗时和文件变更摘要。适合需要快速回看长会话、定位某轮工作或查看编辑概况的 Web 用户。偏好保存在浏览器本地，不需要额外密钥。

dsh-session-nav adds a navigable timeline to DSH Web conversations. Click a tick or use arrow keys to jump between turns, including older history. Hover to view prompt text, elapsed time, and file change summaries. A header button toggles the overlay; the preference is saved locally.
想在很长的 DSH 对话里快速跳回之前某一轮。
给 DSH Web 加一条能点选的会话时间线。
我想查看每轮对话大概花了多长时间。
能不能从侧边的刻度直接定位到旧消息？
希望回看尚未载入当前聊天窗口的早期会话内容。
想知道某一轮对话改了哪些文件、增删了多少行。
I want a timeline to jump between turns in a long DSH conversation.
Show me how long each conversation turn took.
Help me find older messages that are not loaded in the chat yet.
dsh-session-nav 的功能「会话时间线导航」：在对话左侧为用户、引导、命令和手动压缩消息显示刻度。点击刻度或按上下方向键即可跳到对应消息。
dsh-session-nav 的功能「旧消息导航」：从会话历史分页整理尚未载入聊天窗口的用户消息。点击对应刻度后逐页载入较旧内容，并在消息出现后滚动定位。
dsh-session-nav 的功能「悬停轮次摘要」：指向时间线刻度可查看该轮提示文本和运行耗时；若有文件变更，还会显示文件数、路径及增删行数。

dsh-session-nav README · dsh-session-nav：[](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) **Web** plugin that adds a Codex-style session navigator on the left of the conversation.

It is an overlay only. It does not replace Chat, the sidebar, or the Trajectory tab.

dsh-session-nav README · What you get：- **Idle:** a packed stack of short dashes on the left edge of the conversation column — one dash per user, steering, or slash-command turn.
- **Hover:** neighbouring dashes lengthen in a delayed wave, then a prompt bubble, an optional **Worked for** duration, and an optional **Edited N files +X −Y** card.
- **Jump:** click a dash (or use ↑ / ↓ on the rail) to scroll that turn into view.
- **Full log:** older turns are listed from `session.history` even if Chat has not loaded them yet. Clicking one pages `loadOlder` until the row exists, then scrolls to it.
- **Toggle:** a tick-mark button in the session header. Preference is stored as `dsh-session-nav:enabled` in `localStorage`.
dsh-session-nav README · What you get：The rail sits vertically centered, capped at 66% of the conversation column, and scrolls inside itself when the stack is long.

dsh-session-nav README · Install：Wait until DSH is idle. Adding a plugin rebuilds the web profile and will interrupt a running task.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:karmiy/dsh-session-nav
```

Git-hosted plugins build on install. pnpm ≥10 blocks that `prepare` script until you allow it, so the first `add` fails with an `allowBuilds` hint. Copy the exact key into `~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml`:

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  dsh-session-nav: true
```

Then run the same `add` again and restart the web profile.

dsh-session-nav README · Install：Pin a commit if you do not want a later push to change what runs:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:karmiy/dsh-session-nav#v0.1.0
```

Local checkout (after `pnpm install`):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-session-nav
```

Find more community plugins under the [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic.

dsh-session-nav README · How it maps to the session：| UI | Source |
| --- | --- |
| One tick | A visible `user`, `steering`, `command`, or `manual-compaction` Chat Node in the loaded window, plus older human `user/message` events from `session.history` |
| Idle length | Short dash; hover applies a Gaussian envelope around the pointer |
| Scroll mark | Slightly brighter dash nearest the upper third of `[data-conversation-scroll]` — not expanded |
| Worked for / bubble / file card | Shown only while the pointer is on the rail |
| Worked for | `turn/start` … `turn/end` (live while the turn is open) |
| Bubble | Text of that user / steering / slash-command message |
| File card | Diff / edit tool cards in the turn (`locations` + `oldText` / `newText` line counts) |

dsh-session-nav README · Development：Requires Node `^22.19 || >=24`. Keep a DeepSeek Harness checkout as a sibling if you want `pnpm typecheck` / `pnpm build` (they resolve host types through `../deepseek-harness`). Unit tests and `prepare` do not need it.

```text
../deepseek-harness
../dsh-session-nav
```

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm test
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build

`prepare` runs `tsdown` only — no typecheck — so `dsh plugin add github:…` can build on a machine that does not have the harness source.
dsh-session-nav README · Development：Do not `dsh plugin add` against a profile that is currently running a task.
